system.name: BlitzScale
system.one_liner: a large-model autoscaling system that achieves fast, live scaling with O(1) host-side parameter caching

components.name: Load monitor & trigger
components.role: tracks per-model serving load and decides whether/how many new instances to scale (§5.3)

components.name: Scale planner
components.role: derives a scaling plan guiding how to load parameters onto scaled instances efficiently (§5.1)

components.name: Global parameter pool
components.role: identifies the sources of model parameters across GPUs/hosts for the scale planner to consult

components.name: Local model cache
components.role: caches model parameters locally on a host (e.g., in a server's CPU memory) to accelerate scaling

components.name: Live exe. Scheduler
components.role: redirects requests between instances to utilize scaled instances even before parameters are fully loaded (§5.2)

components.name: Model executor
components.role: executes the model on the managed GPUs of each server

components.name: GPU servers managed by the BlitzScale
components.role: the pool of physical servers (0 through N) that host GPUs and are orchestrated by BlitzScale

flows.what: parameters loaded from a GPU or host CPU memory source

content.key_idea: BlitzScale adds a scale planner that consults a global parameter pool to find the fastest source for model parameters, and a live execution scheduler that redirects requests to scaling instances before their parameters finish loading, on top of a conventional load-monitor-triggered autoscaling loop.
content.reading_order: Top row shows the Global parameter pool and Local model cache resources; the numbered ①-④ middle row (Load monitor & trigger, Scale planner, Live exe. Scheduler, Model executor) reads left to right; the bottom row shows the pool of GPU servers (0..N) that these components manage.

summary: This figure shows the system architecture of BlitzScale, a large-model autoscaling system. Like prior autoscaling systems, a Load monitor & trigger tracks per-model serving load and decides when and how much to scale. BlitzScale's contributions, marked in red, are a Scale planner that derives an efficient scaling plan by consulting a Global parameter pool to find the fastest source for model parameters (e.g., another GPU's memory or a host's CPU-cached copy via a Local model cache), and a Live exe. Scheduler that redirects requests to newly scaled instances even before their parameters are fully loaded. A Model executor runs inference on the GPUs of each server, and the bottom row shows the pool of GPU servers (numbered 0 through N) that BlitzScale manages. The diagram is a dense, flat-filled boxes-and-arrows architecture drawing with red highlighting for the paper's novel modules and an inline annotation illustrating a concrete parameter-caching example.
summary_zh: 该图展示 BlitzScale 的系统架构：负载监控与触发器决定何时扩容，新增的规划器咨询全局参数池以确定最快的参数来源（如某主机 CPU 缓存的模型副本），执行调度器在参数完全加载前就将请求重定向到新实例，底层由一组 GPU 服务器承载，图中以红色标出新增模块。
